rules.statement: A reissue of a writ is not vitiated by the fact that the judgment-creditor has failed to mention to the Court a payment made by the judgment-debtor before such reissue; and an innocent purchaser under such writ is not affected by such failure.
rules.supporting_quote: "It would be well if practitioners make it a rule never to reissue an old writ.
